Container.Name: 2110-DAW
Container.Overview: Soundbending Live (formerly 2110 DAW): browser-based DAW with Live, Studio and Soundcheck modes. Open the HTTPS port in Chrome; browsers only allow audio interfaces on HTTPS. To receive AES67 / ST 2110-30 network audio, set Network Type to a custom network on the media network (e.g. br0 with a fixed IP); the default bridge network doesn't pass multicast.

Config.Name: HTTPS port
Config.Description: Open this one in Chrome: https://your-server-ip:8443

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Plain HTTP. Only useful behind a reverse proxy that adds HTTPS.

Config.Name: Certificate hostnames
Config.Description: Server IP and/or hostname for the self-signed certificate, comma separated, e.g. 192.168.1.50,tower.local

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Keeps the HTTPS certificate (put your own cert.pem and key.pem in certs/ to use them) and third-party plugins (one folder per Web Audio Module in plugins/).
